summary.text: Savannah Maddox is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 61 since 2019 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Savannah Maddox was born in Dry Ridge, Kentucky.

She earned a bachelor of arts in history and international relations from Northern Kentucky University and has been a member of the Grant County Chamber of Commerce and the Grant County Historical Society.
Maddox assumed office on January 1, 2019, succeeding Brian E. Linder (R).
In the 2025-2026 session she served on the House Judiciary, State Government, Local Government, and Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection committees.
